methods: Twitter syndication endpoint with derived public token

posts.author: RippleXity
posts.preserved_summary: RippleXity says its investigation began after Hwan reported depositing 29,899.8 XRP into XORA Finance and being unable to access the funds.

posts.author: gimgyeongh62101
posts.preserved_summary: Hwan publishes a post titled XORA Finance – My XRP Withdrawal Timeline, describes it as a factual account rather than an accusation, and asks for a technical explanation of what happened to the XRP.

posts.author: gimgyeongh62101
posts.preserved_summary: Hwan says that after the withdrawal issue he received different explanations and publishes two screenshots as supporting material.

media.preserved_summary: Claimant-published screenshot depicts a message attributed to Joren Lundgren saying the affected person fell for a phishing website, never had an account with XORA, and that a fake XORA website existed.
media.authentication_boundary: The screenshot is preserved as claimant-published media. CYA has not independently authenticated the depicted sender/account or established that it refers to the same off-chain account as the deposit tag.

media.preserved_summary: Claimant-published screenshot depicts a DM interface labeled Xora Finance / @xora_finance discussing a stuck withdrawal, matching an X account to XORA destination tag 287588244, and describing a manual AML hold with withdrawal freeze and lifetime cap 0. The same published image also depicts a completed Binance XRP withdrawal of 29,899.8 XRP to the XORA-attributed treasury with tag 287588244 and transaction ID 4FD202B3DB7ADCA94ABDF3CC06762A3B2DD615532E13B531B1737E14788C09AA.
media.privacy: A private email address visible in the screenshot is intentionally omitted from the normalized record.
media.authentication_boundary: The support UI is preserved as claimant-published media and is not treated as an independently authenticated XORA support archive. The XRP transaction/hash/tag shown in the same image are independently corroborated by the separate XRPL full-history probe.

posts.author: XRPDegens
posts.preserved_summary: XRPDegens says the transaction ID confirms the deposit into the official XORA wallet and discusses XORA's reported explanation of the case.

posts.author: DNF_sol
posts.preserved_summary: DNF_sol describes Hwan's post as the final summary from the person involved in the case.

independent_corroboration.linkage: The exact transaction hash, amount, destination treasury and destination tag displayed in the claimant-published Binance screenshot match the independently reproduced XRPL transaction.

video_review.summary: The retrieved short video is primarily an INVESTIGATION / evidence-sources-truth title animation and does not add transaction or account evidence beyond the accompanying post text.

interpretation_boundary: The public screenshots materially connect the independently verified deposit transaction/tag to Hwan's published account of the dispute, but they remain claimant-published evidence rather than authenticated XORA internal records.
The depicted manual AML-hold explanation and the depicted phishing/no-account explanation can be recorded only as attributed, conflicting account narratives.
The requested withdrawal destination and final settlement/customer outcome remain unresolved.
Nothing in this record establishes fraud, scam, insolvency, permanent loss or a recovery rate.
